focus.jtag: Chipmakers and AI data-center names lead the tape lower into Nvidia's Tuesday print; the 10-year holds above 5% and a December Fed hike stays in play. The scanner boarded three Type A bearish names — but all three carry aging or imperfect catalysts
focus.jnote: The scanner boarded names, but the tape is fragile — that's the signal. On Friday the S&P 500 fell 0.40% to 7,561.67 while the Nasdaq 100 dropped 1.22%, yet the equal-weighted S&P rose 0.17%. The VIX rose 3.21% to 19.30, while the one-day gauge jumped 16.51% to 18.63. This morning futures stayed soft — S&P 500 futures were down 0.34% and Nasdaq 100 futures down 0.87% as the AI unwind continued. The dominant driver is single-name AI risk into a print: turmoil at Nvidia after CEO Jensen Huang's exit keeps tech under pressure ahead of its earnings on Tuesday, and CoreWeave, Nebius and IREN each fell more than 5% premarket on worry that Nvidia's new leadership takes a more cautious stance toward funding AI-infrastructure firms. With US retail sales Tuesday then Nvidia earnings after the close, and FOMC minutes Wednesday, a Sniper does not open new premium.
focus.notdown: Energy and defensives were the relative-bid groups as investors moved into staples, communication services and energy while AI-stock selling resumed. But energy is a two-sided supply trade, not a clean Sniper: WTI slipped below $88 Monday as a global supply surplus weighed, with a 52-million-barrel rise in October inventories — the first monthly build since June. No energy name cleared the scanner. Watch-only.
focus.notup: Chipmakers and neocloud/AI-infrastructure names are the natural bearish lean — and the scanner's three boarded names all lean that way or into weak fundamentals. But the catalysts are aging (HBM and NBIS gapped 2–4 sessions ago) and selling bear calls into a VIX-rising AI tape the day before NVDA's print carries violent two-sided squeeze risk. Sell nothing new today.
focus.why: Why RED? Three things stack. One: P(≥1% gap) at ~42% is well above the 35% trigger and composite 58 is WARM — either locks out GREEN. Two: Nvidia reports Tuesday after the close with FOMC minutes Wednesday — two live, mega-cap/macro catalysts inside any normal DTE. Three: the three boarded names are honored on the board but all carry aging or imperfect catalysts (ARMK and NBIS actually beat; HBM/NBIS gapped days ago) into a falling AI tape. Stand down on new credit spreads, treat the board as watch-only, and re-run tomorrow. Cash is a position today.
